home_about_title: A living monument to faith and freedom
home_about_p1: Emmanuel Church at Kengeleni stands in Kongowea, near Nyali Bridge. It was established in 1889, is one of the oldest Anglican churches in Kenya, and is a National Heritage Site.
home_about_p2: It was built to serve freed slaves resettled at Frere Town, the settlement the Church Missionary Society founded on the mainland across from Mombasa Island. The church became a place of worship, learning and new beginnings for them and their families.
home_about_p3: Today the parish is part of the ACK Diocese of Mombasa, and its members meet across the area in Home Based Cells (HBCs).
home_bell_body: The bell beside the church gave the area its name. It was rung to warn the community of approaching slave traders, and to call people to worship. A replica hangs there today.
home_ministries_intro: Find your place to serve and grow in faith.
home_ministry_kama: Kenya Anglican Men's Association. Men growing in spirit, mind and body, nurtured in faith for every good work.
home_ministry_mu: Christian women promoting the wellbeing of families and stable family life.
home_ministry_kayo: Kenya Anglican Youth Organization. Young people living responsible and meaningful lives in Christ.
home_ministry_children: Nurturing the next generation through the Gospel, wholesome growth and Christ-centred teaching.
home_hbc_intro: Our fellowship continues in homes across Freretown and nearby, in small groups for worship, Bible study and prayer. Each is named after a place in the Bible. They meet on Mondays, 5:30–6:30 pm.

privacy_intro: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni ("the parish", "we") keeps the church's register of members. This notice explains what we collect, why, where it is kept, who can see it, how long we keep it and your rights under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019. The parish is the data controller: it decides how your information is used and is responsible for it.
privacy_collect_body:
Your full name.
Your FWO number, or that you are new and don't have one yet.
Your mobile number, or that you have no phone of your own.
Your Home Based Cell (HBC), and the HBCs you belonged to before.
The departments you belong to, if you tell us.
That you are 18 or older, that you read this notice, and that you agreed to storage outside Kenya.
Your preferred language.
Your registration reference, its status, and the reasons for staff decisions about it.
How your phone number was checked: by a one-time code, or by an officer who saw you in person.
In church elections: that you could vote, that you voted, when, and whether online or in person. Never how you voted.
If you stand in a church election: that you were nominated, for which position, and by whom. If you nominate or second someone: that you did.
privacy_collect_not: We do not collect your date of birth, ID number, address or photo.
privacy_collect_source: Most of this comes from you, on the registration form or at a registration desk. If you were on the church's member list, we added your name, FWO number, mobile number, HBC, departments and preferred language from it, with your permission.
privacy_collect_visits: When you use the registration, status or voting pages, we also process your IP address and information from your browser, to protect the pages from abuse (limits on how often codes can be sent, and Cloudflare's check that you are not a robot). One-time codes are stored only in a scrambled form and deleted within two days.
privacy_why_body:
To keep an accurate register of the parish's adult members.
To run church elections for HBCs, departments and the parish: to take nominations, to check who may vote, to let you vote online with your own phone or in person, and to make sure each member votes only once. We record that you voted, never how you voted.
To send you SMS about your registration: that we received it, if we need you to contact us, and when it is approved.
To let you check your registration status.
privacy_why_sensitive: Being a member of the church says something about your religious belief, which the law treats as sensitive information. We keep it as a religious, not-for-profit body, about our own members, for the church's activities. We never use it for marketing, never sell it, and do not share it outside the parish without your consent.
privacy_where_heading: Where it is kept: outside Kenya
privacy_where_body: The register is stored securely on servers in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). The law allows sensitive information to be stored outside Kenya only with your consent, so the registration form asks for it separately. If you don't agree, you can't register online, but the church office can keep your details on paper instead.
privacy_who_body: Only church staff who manage the register, each as far as their role needs: the Membership Administrator, Registration Officers at registration desks, and two Super Administrators. Staff sign in with a password and a second check. At an election, the election officers check in the register whether you have already voted. Every time a staff member opens your record, searches the register or exports it, that is recorded.
privacy_processors_intro: These companies process your information on the parish's behalf and only for us:
privacy_processors_body:
Neon: stores the register (European Union).
Cloudflare: runs the website, checks that visitors are not robots, and keeps encrypted backups (worldwide network; backups stored in the European Union).
Mobile Sasa (Bitwise Digital Solutions Ltd): sends our SMS (Kenya).
Sentry: receives reports of technical errors, with personal details removed (European Union).
GitHub: runs the nightly backup job on its servers outside the European Union. The register passes through them, and is encrypted there before it is stored in the European Union. No unencrypted copy is kept.
privacy_keep_body:
While you are a member: for as long as you remain a member.
After a member transfers to another church or dies: their name, phone number and departments are removed one year later. Their FWO number is kept, no longer linked to a name, so it is never given to anyone else.
Records of church elections that name you (that you could vote, that you voted, when, and whether online or in person): removed one week after the election's final result is declared.
Nominations (who stood, and who nominated and seconded them): removed two weeks after the election's final result is declared.
Election results: the names of those elected are kept as the church's record of office-holders. Other candidates' names, and every candidate's vote count, are removed one week after the final result; only the totals remain.
A registration that is rejected or withdrawn: your personal details are removed 12 months after the decision. The reference, dates and status are kept.
One-time codes: deleted within two days.
Records of SMS sent: 90 days.
Backups: 35 days.
Technical logs: up to 7 days. They never contain your name, phone or FWO number.
privacy_safe_body: Your information is encrypted when it travels and where it is stored. Only the staff named above can see it, each with their own sign-in and a second check. Every change to a record is recorded and cannot be altered. We have a procedure for responding to a data breach, and we will tell you and the Data Commissioner if one puts you at risk.
privacy_rights_body:
Be told how your information is used (this notice).
See the information we hold about you.
Have wrong information corrected.
Object to how we use it, or ask us to delete it, where the law allows.
Withdraw your consent to storage outside Kenya. The church office will explain what happens to your record and can keep your details on paper.
Complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (www.odpc.go.ke).
privacy_rights_how: To use these rights, contact the church office (details below). You can check your registration status yourself on the status page.
privacy_contact_body: ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni, P.O. Box 85010-80100, Mombasa. Email: ackemmanuelkengeleni@gmail.com. Phone: +254 790 255515. The Vicar is responsible for data protection in the parish.
privacy_changes_body: When we change this notice, we change its version number. Each registration records the version that was agreed to. If a change affects your consent, we will ask you again.
terms_intro: This website belongs to ACK Emmanuel Freretown - Kengeleni. By using it you agree to these terms. Our privacy notice explains how we use your information.
terms_register_body:
Register only yourself. An officer at a registration desk may register you with you present.
Give true and complete details.
Use a phone number that is yours alone. If you don't have one, the church office will register you.
You must be 18 or older.
Registering does not by itself make you a member of the register: the church reviews every registration and may approve it, ask you to correct it, or reject it.
terms_use_body:
Don't try to see or change anyone else's information.
Don't try to get around the site's security, overload it, or use automated tools on it.
Don't use it for anything unlawful.
We may block anyone who misuses the site.
terms_availability_body: We try to keep the website working, but we can't promise it will always be available or free of errors. If it isn't working, the church office can register you or tell you your status.
terms_law_body: We may change these terms; the date at the top shows the current version. These terms are governed by the laws of Kenya.
cookies_intro: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. We use only the cookies the site needs to work and stay secure. We don't use cookies for analytics, advertising or tracking, so we don't show a cookie banner.
cookies_ours_body:
PARAGLIDE_LOCALE: remembers the language you chose (English or Kiswahili). Kept for one year.
Staff portal only: sign-in cookies (the session and the second sign-in check), and Cloudflare Access's sign-in cookie. They are used only by church staff on the staff portal.
cookies_security_body: Cloudflare, which runs the website, may set its own security cookies, such as cf_clearance or __cf_bm, on any page when it checks for robots or automated traffic, to remember that a visitor passed its checks. They are not used for advertising. Cloudflare explains them on its Cloudflare Cookies page.
cookies_control_body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you do, the site may forget your language, and the check that you are not a robot may not work, so you may not be able to get a code.
